claims.note: Title and description restate the headline measurements: 1.80 of 5 rows at 12 tenants over 168 queries and 3.20 foreign rows in the raw top-5, both read from summary.json. Both strings match the schema partial exactly.

run.methodology: Exact-cosine sweep over the synthetic 30-tenant fixture with committed all-minilm vectors; 108 configurations (n=2/5/12/30 x k=3/5/10 x post_filter/scoped/leak x single/multi/all). Aggregate means, minima, under-fill shares, foreign-row counts and gold-in-context rates were read from summary.json, not estimated.

claims.note: Illustrative snippet of the pattern under test (global search, then list comprehension). It is the code shape the harness implements, not a measurement.
Opening numbers: 1.80 of 5 rows, minimum 1, 98.2% short, 3.20 of 5 foreign rows at 12 tenants over the 168-query mixed set, all from summary.json n=12 k=5 kind=all.

run.methodology: Exact-cosine sweep over the synthetic 30-tenant fixture with committed all-minilm vectors; 108 configurations (n=2/5/12/30 x k=3/5/10 x post_filter/scoped/leak x single/multi/all). claims.note: Section heading naming the configuration whose results are reported in the table that follows (12 tenants, k=5). It asserts no number by itself.

Fixture parameters (30 tenants, 10 fact types, 10 single-gold plus 4 multi-fact queries per tenant - 14 per tenant, 168 at 12 tenants and 420 at 30 - all-minilm 384-d) as implemented in the committed fixture and harness; query counts read from the distinct qids in results.jsonl (120 single + 48 multi at n=12) and documents from the 300 committed doc vectors.

run.methodology: Deterministic synthetic fixture: 30 tenants x 10 fact types, values from three templates per fact type by pure integer hash; no real or customer data.

claims.note: Lead-in sentence for the table; the k=5 mixed population and the two strategies compared are described in the rows that follow.

claims.note: Every cell is a summary.json aggregate for kind=all, k=5: n=2 mean 3.929 / 96.4% short / 1.071 foreign; n=5 1.843 / 100% / 3.157; n=12 1.798 / 98.2% / 3.202; n=30 1.836 / 97.4% / 3.164. Scoped rows are exactly k in every configuration.

claims.note: Population reconciliation: 1.798 from 168 mixed queries in the 120-document store (120x1.5667 + 48x2.375 / 168 = 1.7976), 1.5667 for single-gold only, 1.3833 for the same 120 queries scored over 300 documents. recheck.json reproduced results.jsonl on 120/120 rows.

run.methodology: Fresh exact-cosine rescoring written independently of harness.py from the committed vectors; reproduced results.jsonl per-query counts on 120/120 single-gold k=5 post_filter rows and the three reported means for their distinct populations.

claims.note: Gold-in-context at n=12 k=5 read per population from results.jsonl and summary.json: post_filter single 1.000 (120/120), multi 0.875 (42/48); scoped 1.000 for both. The 0.964 figure is kind=all over the mixed 168-query set, not the single-gold rate. The 1.57 single-gold mean returned rows is recheck.json sweep_n12_single_k5.

run.methodology: Exact-cosine sweep over the synthetic 30-tenant fixture with committed all-minilm vectors; 108 configurations (n=2/5/12/30 x k=3/5/10 x post_filter/scoped/leak x single/multi/all). claims.note: Leak-path comparison: identical gold rates per kind (1.000 single, 0.875 multi; 0.964 over the mixed 168-query set) with 3.202 foreign rows in the raw top-5 at n=12, and the selftest mean of 3.617 foreign rows / 72.3% over the 300-document store, computed from the 120 per-query lines in probe_selftest.txt.

run.methodology: isolation_probe.py --selftest run against the committed reference adapter over the full 300-document fixture; 120 single-gold queries at 12 tenants, per-query PASS/FAIL lines saved verbatim.

claims.note: pgvector README wording on post-scan filtering with hnsw.ef_search 40 and ~4 matching rows at 10% selectivity, plus the iterative-scan sentence and the 0.8.0 CHANGELOG line (2024-10-30), both read from the saved pages on 2026-11-14. Scope is limited to pgvector approximate-index usage.

Chroma where-in-query and Qdrant partition-by-payload with a keyword payload index and is_tenant true, each limited to what its page states; the paragraph explicitly claims no fill or performance behaviour for either product.
The four assertions and their exact predicates as implemented in the shipped isolation_probe.py; no measurement is asserted in this list.
Selftest outcome over 300 documents and 120 queries at 12 tenants: A1, A2, A3, A4 pass 120/120; A1b fails 119/120 at k=5. Counted from the per-query check lines in probe_selftest.txt.

numbers.note: Every figure is traceable to summary.json, results.jsonl, recheck.json, probe_selftest.txt or a source quote. Round-2 review re-derived the aggregates directly from results.jsonl (1.7976 mean/0.9821 short/3.2024 foreign at n=12 k=5; 1.5667 single-gold; 2.375 multi-fact; 1.5536 and 2.2321 at k=3/k=10; gold-in-context 1.000 single both strategies, 0.875 vs 1.000 multi, 0.9643 mixed) and re-ran the harness offline, which reproduced results.jsonl and summary.json byte-identically. Gold-in-context is reported per query kind; 0.964 is the mixed 168-query set only. No figure is extrapolated to a leak rate or to any vendor.

model_ids.note: One embedder named exactly as recorded: all-minilm:latest, digest 1b226e2802db, 384 dimensions, used locally through Ollama 0.20.3. No hosted model or provider is asserted.

pricing.note: No price, cost or quota claim; the sweep used a local embedding endpoint with no paid API. Monetary cost is unknown and no figure is stated.

Sweep executed 2026-11-14 17:44Z (34.97 s), rescoring 18:54Z, round-2 corrections 19:12Z, offline reproducibility re-run 19:26Z.

benchmarks.note: Not a performance benchmark: counts of returned rows and gold-in-context rates over a deterministic synthetic fixture, labelled as such. No latency, throughput or quality-score claim.

cover.note: No cover image used; none generated (no paid image generator invoked) and no existing cover to preserve.

evidence_boundary: Published originals are the probe, harness, fixture, committed vectors, results, aggregates, rescoring output, selftest output, environment record and method. The four fetched third-party pages are kept privately under sources/ for verification and are not republished; the article links upstream.
proposed_process_improvements: Record for later reviewed maintenance: the research brief and this receipt both had to reconcile three means from overlapping populations; a research-stage field naming each population's (query set, store size) tuple at the point of measurement would remove the ambiguity before the write stage.

Record for later reviewed maintenance: fixture and population counts must be derived mechanically from query ids and summary aggregates (120 single + 48 multi at n=12; 10 fact rows per tenant) rather than restated from prose, and every gold-in-context rate must carry its query kind. Round 1 stated 5 multi-fact per tenant (15) against 4 committed (14) and attributed the mixed-set 96.4% rate to single-gold queries; a generated counts table in the research artifact would have caught both.
